title: Deep Inlet Terminal Harvest Area Fishery Announcement
full_text:
Forest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Sitka Area Office 304 Lake Street, Room 103 Sitka, AK 99833

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 27, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Aaron Dupuis Sitka Area Management Biologist aaron.dupuis@alaska.gov (907) 747-6688

DEEP INLET TERMINAL HARVEST AREA FISHERY ANNOUNCEMENT

The Deep Inlet Terminal Harvest Area (THA) will be closed to all common property commercial salmon fisheries effective 12:01 a.m., Monday, August 31, 2026. This closure will remain in effect until further notice.

The Northern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association (NSRAA) has requested the Alaska Department of Fish and Game (ADF&G) close the Deep Inlet THA to all common property commercial salmon fisheries beginning on Monday, August 31, to achieve chum salmon broodstock goals. NSRAA will provide updates daily to ADF&G on the progress of their broodstock operations in this area.

The Emergency Order corresponding with this announcement is EO 1E3026.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
